title: athyrium henryi
intro: Athyrium henryi, commonly known as Chinese Lady Fern or Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Athyriaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote overall well-being, and it is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium henryi include its ability to calm and soothe the nervous system, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
